title: Bonnie Tyler dies – level 2
paragraphs: The famous Welsh singer Bonnie Tyler died at the age of 75. Her family announced that she passed away in a hospital in Portugal after being sick for some time.

This news shocked many people because everyone thought she was getting better after surgery. Bonnie Tyler was loved for her big hit songs like Total Eclipse of the Heart and Holding Out for a Hero. She had a very special voice that people could recognize immediately. She got this unique voice by accident after a throat operation in the 1970s. People of all ages still love her music, and her songs have millions of plays online today.
Many fans and friends are very sad about her death, and they will always remember her beautiful and powerful singing.
